title: 22 Qualified Meetings in 90 Days for a Nutraceutical Manufacturer
challenge: A growing nutraceutical manufacturer had strong production capabilities but struggled to connect with distributors, private-label brands and potential commercial partners. Most opportunities came through referrals and exhibitions, making business development inconsistent.
solution: Myntmore developed a targeted LinkedIn growth and outbound strategy:
Identified decision-makers at nutraceutical brands and distribution companies.
Optimised the founder's LinkedIn profile for manufacturing credibility.
Created content highlighting formulation expertise, manufacturing capabilities and partnership opportunities.
results: A repeatable pipeline of potential distribution and private-label partners.
